title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review daily scratchpad
body:
Daily scratchpad — SOC2 evidence / vendor reviews / policy TODOs

Date: 2026-03-06
Owner: Amelia Reyes (sec & compliance)
Context: Quick running notes for evidence collection, follow-ups with vendors, and policy edits. Mostly a personal checklist; will extract action items into JIRA later.

Top priorities for today:
- Finish evidence packet for access reviews (JIRA SOC2-118) — collect screenshots + signed attestations from infra owners. TODO: ping Priya for final OK by EOD.
- Vendor review: Hashicorp Vault rotation proof — we need rotation logs for Q1. Contact: security-contact@vault-vendor.com (ticket created CONFLUENCE-SEC-7421). TODO: ask Noah for latest onboarding doc.
- Policy TODO: update encryption-at-rest policy to include new KMS key lifecycle (draft attached to Confluence). Need product sign-off.

Notes / running log:
- 09:15 — skimmed infra access list export (exported csv from admin panel). Missing two service accounts (svc-redwood-devops, svc-data-sync). Action: open ticket with infra to confirm ownership and justification. (JIRA link placeholder: JIRA-SOC2-119)
- 09:40 — quick call with Priya; she confirmed the signed attestation template but wants the timestamped artifact rather than a static doc. Add timestamp to evidence meta.
- 10:05 — vendor email thread: Vault team needs customer org ID to pull rotation logs — sent org ID, asked for CSV of key rotations for Jan–Mar. Follow-up in 48h.
- 10:30 — walked through Confluence draft for encryption policy; notes: clarify scope for ephemeral cache services, add explicit exception flow and review cadence (annual).
- 11:00 — added draft checklist for evidence packet (below).

Evidence packet checklist (working):
- Access review export (csv) with filters for last 12 months — include which roles, last login dates.
- Signed attestations from app owners (pdf) — Priya to collect for apps: console-api, batch-worker, analytics-pipeline.
- Key rotation logs (vendor-supplied) for KMS/Vault — request in progress, vendor ticket CONFLUENCE-SEC-7421.
- Configuration snapshots (S3 bucket policies, DB encryption flags) — snapshot names: s3-policy-2026-03-04, db-encrypt-2026-03-04. TODO: verify these snapshots are archived to evidence bucket.
- Change history for infra (terraform plan outputs + PR numbers) — include GH PRs: /infra/pull/318, /infra/pull/324 (rotation work).
- Incident/exception docs (any exceptions logged this quarter) — check exceptions board.

Vendor review quick notes:
- Vault vendor: ask for rotation log format (prefer csv with columns: key_id, rotated_at, rotated_by, rotation_type). Confirm timezone (UTC). Also ask for signed confirmation that rotation occurred per SLA.
- Monitoring vendor (MetricsCo): need SOC2 attestation copy and data-retention details (they said 90 days default). Follow up with account manager for SOC2 report. Ticket: JIRA-VENDOR-77.

Action items (assign / due):
- Amelia: compile evidence packet draft and upload to evidence-bucket (due 2026-03-07).
- Priya Desai: collect signed attestations for app owners (due 2026-03-06 EOD).
- Noah Martinez: share onboarding doc + confirm vendor contact for Vault (due 2026-03-08).
- Infra on-call: confirm ownership of svc-redwood-devops and svc-data-sync (due 2026-03-05). Create JIRA-SOC2-119.
- Product owner (TBD): review encryption policy updates (review meeting 2026-03-09).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we need to include ephemeral API keys rotation proof or is service-account rotation sufficient? (Ask infra/arch)
- For vendor-supplied logs, what is acceptable proof: raw logs vs aggregated statement? Need to align with auditor ask (reach out to external auditor contact: audit@redwood-audit.com).
- Is our evidence bucket encryption metadata sufficient (we store kms_key_id as metadata) or do auditors want explicit KMS policy PDF?

Random notes to self:
- Convert this checklist into SOC2-118 subtasks after Priya confirms attestations.
- Keep a running folder: /evidence/soc2/q1-2026/ (ensure archived copies in glacier if required).
- Reminder: sync with product about rollback policy language in encryption doc — they want to avoid operationally impossible language.

Quick snippets for Confluence draft (copy/paste):
- "Encryption-at-rest policy: All customer data at rest must be encrypted using KMS-managed keys. Keys must be rotated at least annually; rotation events must be logged and made available to auditors on request. Exceptions require documented justification and approval by Security PO."
- "Access review cadence: quarterly reviews for all human users; monthly automated scans for service accounts; any account unused for 90 days must be flagged for review."

End of scratchpad — save and then extract action items to JIRA later.

(Informal: might be messy — that's ok, this is my working doc.)
